summary.text: Sallie Fellows is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Grafton 8 who has held the seat since December 5, 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has served on the House Executive Departments and Administration and Ways and Means committees.

paragraphs.text: Sallie Fellows assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 5, 2018.
Ballotpedia lists her on the House Executive Departments and Administration Committee in the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions and on the House Ways and Means Committee in 2023-2024.
